pai_behaviour.reject_plan_parameters: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/google.py:2523 always sends `parameters_json_schema`, so `reject_plan`, which ADK declares with no parameters, goes with an empty object schema
pai_behaviour.tools_grouping: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/google.py:1094 puts each function declaration in a `Tool` of its own
pai_behaviour.tool_config: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/google.py:1053-1074 always sends a function calling config with function tools (AUTO in like-adk mode, VALIDATED in validated mode); ADK sends none
pai_behaviour.headers: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/google.py:1256 sends its own headers; ADK sends its tracking headers
pai_behaviour.prefix_key: follows from the three above and from the system instruction going as a `Content` (pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/google.py:1510) where ADK's goes as a string: `prefix_key` hashes each framework's own form, so the two arms never share a cache
pai_behaviour.call_ids: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/google.py:2141 and :1557 send Pydantic AI's tool call id on each replayed function call and response; ADK strips its own client ids
